name: Gangtise MCP
description: Gangtise financial MCP: quotes, research reports, knowledge base, stock pools, and related tools.
description_zh: 岗底斯金融 MCP：远程接入行情、研报、知识库、股票池等约 45 个工具，用开放平台 AK/SK 鉴权。
description_en: Gangtise financial MCP: remote access to quotes, research, knowledge base, and stock pools with open-platform AK/SK.
examples_zh: 查询贵州茅台最近一周的行情和成交量
搜索新能源相关的最新研报并摘要要点
把这份 PDF 研报导入知识库并回答其中的估值假设
查看我的股票池今日涨跌与持仓摘要
生成某只股票的一页纸公司概况
examples_en: Get last week's price and volume for a China A-share ticker
Search recent research reports on EVs and summarize key points
Ingest a PDF report into the knowledge base and answer valuation questions
Show today's moves for my stock pool
Generate a one-pager company overview for a ticker
